XSD.scope: six official XSD files, exact supplied dependency modules, five roots; XSD 1.0 semantics; no DTD/XSLT or prose norms
XSD.id_policy: MX40-XSD- + first 16 hex SHA256(file + | + stable XPath); properties append @name. IDs identify source occurrences, not runtime error-code architecture.

prose.publication_status: Final Community Group Report, 1 June 2021; not a W3C Recommendation
prose.rule_id_policy: MX40-PROSE- plus stable semantic slug; does not depend on row number
prose.scope: All 642 annotations of six pinned XSD modules; the complete 974-page pinned 4.0 HTML corpus was inventoried and its normative prose reviewed, with explicit exclusions for old-version history and illustrative code/data. External normative dependency closure is separate.
prose.coverage_claim: complete scoped MusicXML 4.0 prose corpus review; not a proof of complete transitive external standard validation
prose.quote_policy: No verbatim passages reproduced in deliverables. Rules are paraphrases with exact source locators.
prose.implementation_status: Research artifacts only. No Go code, tests, product or repository changes.

record.description: Sequence order

parameters.neutral_rule: L(sequence)=concatenate(L(child_1),...,L(child_n))

record.description: Choice alternatives

parameters.neutral_rule: L(choice)=union(L(child_1),...,L(child_n)); nullable branches remain nullable

record.description: Particle bounds

parameters.neutral_rule: L(particle)=repeat(L(term),minOccurs,maxOccurs); omitted bounds=1

record.description: Declared type assessment

parameters.neutral_rule: value/content satisfies resolved type

record.description: Attribute presence

parameters.neutral_rule: required => present; optional => zero_or_one; omitted use=optional

record.description: Schema default

parameters.neutral_rule: effective_value=typed(default); physical_absence remains provenance

record.description: Fixed value

parameters.neutral_rule: typed(actual)=typed(fixed); absent optional fixed contributes defaulted value

record.description: Closed content

parameters.neutral_rule: only declared attributes and child grammar; standard xsi exceptions apply

record.description: Text-content category

parameters.neutral_rule: simple=>typed text/no children; element_only=>XML whitespace between children; empty=>no character/element children

record.description: Nil legality

parameters.neutral_rule: nillable=false when absent; xsi:nil=true disallowed; xsi:nil lexical boolean checked

record.description: Dynamic type assessment

parameters.neutral_rule: QName resolves; dynamic type validly derived; block constraints honored

record.description: Blocked derivation/substitution

parameters.neutral_rule: reject blocked derivation/substitution path

record.description: Final derivation declaration

parameters.neutral_rule: final constrains schema derivation/substitution membership, not an unconditional ban on xsi:type

record.description: Typed enumeration

parameters.neutral_rule: typed(value) in typed(enumeration_values); same-restriction values are alternatives

record.description: XSD regular expression

parameters.neutral_rule: XSD10_REGEX_FULL_MATCH(normalized_lexical,pattern); XML Schema Unicode escapes/classes

record.description: Numeric bounds

parameters.neutral_rule: typed(value) >=,>,<=,< typed(bound) according to facet

record.description: Character length

parameters.neutral_rule: count_XML_characters(value)>=minLength; not UTF-8 bytes

record.description: Restriction inheritance

parameters.neutral_rule: base validity AND new facets; preserve per-derivation layers

record.description: Extension inheritance

parameters.neutral_rule: inherit base content/attributes; append extension content and attribute uses

record.description: Union member alternatives

parameters.neutral_rule: exists member valid; member-specific whitespace and value space; declaration member order retained

record.description: Datatype whitespace

parameters.neutral_rule: preserve|replace|collapse per datatype; union uses successful member

record.description: Datatype lexical space

parameters.neutral_rule: lexical form valid before value-space facets

record.description: ID uniqueness

parameters.neutral_rule: all ID values unique within validation root/document

record.description: IDREF resolution

parameters.neutral_rule: each IDREF has corresponding ID in validation root/document

record.description: Schema import

parameters.neutral_rule: use pinned imported namespace declarations; location is a hint, not document fetch mandate

record.description: Reference substitution
